title: Minimal surfaces in $\mathbb{H}^2\times\mathbb{R}$ with finite total curvature and embedded ends
summary: In this paper we study the global geometry and classification of complete minimal surfaces with embedded ends and finite total curvature in the product space $\mathbb{H}^2 \times \mathbb{R}$. We describe the structure of embedded ends of such surfaces, constraining the combinatorics of their asymptotic polygons at infinity. Focusing on small total curvature values, we establish a complete classification of the possible asymptotic boundaries for embedded minimal surfaces with total curvature $-4π$ and $-6π$.
